stories.title: GL.iNet Routers, KVMs Compromised via Remote Management Service Flaw
stories.description: Attackers abused a flaw in the GoodCloud remote management service to push malware to devices, and cleaning them requires new firmware.

stories.title: iTerm2 Remote Code Execution Flaw Lets Hackers Run Malicious Commands by Displaying Crafted Files
stories.description: An iTerm2 flaw allows malicious files to execute commands when displayed in a vulnerable terminal session, without running scripts.

stories.title: Jailbroken AI Agent Helps Hacker Steal Customer Data and 8.6GB of European Government Files
stories.description: Low-skilled hacker BabidiGhost used a jailbroken AI agent to steal insurer data and 8.6GB of files from European municipalities.

stories.title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in Massive $43.9 Billion Cybersecurity Deal
stories.description: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in a $43.9 billion all-stock deal that would bring cloud network security to its Falcon platform.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ScreenConnect Flaw to Hijack MSP Technician PCs Without Warning
stories.description: Attackers exploit CVE-2026-84869 in ConnectWise ScreenConnect to execute malware on MSP technician PCs and deploy rogue remote access clients.

stories.title: N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation
stories.description: N-able patched critical Mail Assure SSRF flaw CVE-2026-134624 during a cloud breach investigation; its role in the attack remains unknown.

stories.title: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Center Urges Users Not to Share Confidential Data on WhatsApp Web
stories.description: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Center (I4C) has urged users not to share confidential data on WhatsApp Web and to log out manually after every session.

stories.title: AI Inference Providers Failed to Detect Hacking and Prompt Theft, Says Dragos
stories.description: Dragos uncovered undetected intrusions at three AI inference providers using nearly two million prompts sent to AI services.

stories.title: BadBox 3.0 Ad Fraud Operation Generating 40 Billion Daily Bid Requests Disrupted
stories.description: Backdoors on low-cost consumer devices served modules for ad fraud and for turning devices into residential proxies.

stories.title: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: Threat actors could exploit them to leak or modify server information and to execute commands as root.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
stories.description: Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-131914, a critical unpatched Idunno.AntiCsrf flaw enabling unauthenticated RCE in ASP.NET WebForms.

stories.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
stories.description: Hackers exploited a GL.iNet GoodCloud flaw to infect routers and KVMs. Security firmware removes identified malware, but persistence concerns remain.
